task.description: Validate test design completeness for TM-04/TM-05. Hard gate before TEST-RUNNER. Confirm every MUST requirement has runnable integration/E2E coverage, no deferred tests, and lifecycle flows are fully asserted (authz, idempotency, UI state actions).
acceptance_criteria: PASS if TM-04/TM-05 test design is complete and runnable
FAIL with concrete gaps if missing coverage

result.summary: Test design validation failed for TM-04/TM-05: MUST coverage exists, but hard-gate checks failed on env-missing skip behavior, fixture UUID isolation, and hardcoded credentials in E2E tests.

issues.description: Integration tests covering MUST requirements use error.SkipZigTest when BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent, which violates the hard-gate requirement that env-missing must fail clearly (not skip). Evidence: tests/integration/tm01_tenant_list_test.zig lines 21-24.

Integration fixtures for TM-04/TM-05 use static slugs (e.g., tc-tm-04-01, tc-tm-05-01) instead of per-test UUID-based identifiers, violating fixture isolation requirements. Evidence: tests/integration/tm01_tenant_list_test.zig lines 397, 423, 500, 530, 560.

E2E test file contains hardcoded fallback credentials (admin-user/admin-pass), violating test security rules that forbid hardcoded credentials. Evidence: web/tests/e2e/tenants.e2e.spec.ts lines 45-46.
